<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Decision:</strong> The MPC kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% with a neutral stance, citing global risks and inflation, while simultaneously upgrading the FY27 GDP growth projection to 6.7% and lowering inflation forecasts.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPc0Z5UDVrS1lYbjBNbDNqVFQzVktNTWVnclp2T1BINWEwRmRFOHF4LV81LWNtY0ZyYWFtLUJ4enpmTlJ4czJiWUsyWk1QbkFQSl83SDJTdElHQzVzYWtDMzZLMzZLMVZvZ2xrMnlaOUVPRnhWUU04MjRDZFd1MUhjdjlEU3lEbDdlZ3VzNmFSSWE1a0ZOR2dmcXd4OThPTEx6MWZLMVRWNjA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPUGZIREJDa3dmR2VkekpWMkdaMkpYSk5IZWk0U1lCQTl5MFZObWFJa0VpS25ONDF5ZHRPenhRTDVqNGUwbXlkdmJNMG92Q1k0Z0JqRVFjTnBJU0xvOTh3QWVLVTc0WHRiREtDTTNfZjU3WDlDcGVBLU5ZeEF4UnJiY1FtZ2h5amhIX0o0Wm4tWURvbW52LWtRNUtjZm5RQVAtWnk3Zkg4SzNud29saXFNOVpXT1hvYUtUVVdCd25ZMWcwZndQX1lmZXdn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I47</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> Indian equities closed higher as the policy decision and a cooling in crude oil prices boosted sentiment, with the Sensex rising significantly on broad-based support including IT sector strength and FII-DII buying.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I77</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I79</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and Bonds:</strong> The rupee reached a one-month closing high supported by declining oil prices, while the RBI’s improved inflation outlook helped stabilize bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>
